about: Chris’s 24 skills, in LORE.md §12’s order, on the classic curve (level 99 needs 13,034,431 XP). Names and mantles are LORE §21’s. Each guide lists a skill’s unlocks with the phase that brings them, and phase4 is the one line saying where its XP comes from today (the sources are content/xp.json’s). Milo’s own six arts stay in src/skills.js.

families.life: Life skills rise from real work only.
families.gathering: Gathering skills rise from what’s gathered in the vale and the wilds.
families.making: Making and roaming skills rise from what you make and where the company goes.

skills.name: Artifice
skills.lore: The Maker’s craft: building things that work.
skills.risesFrom: Code tasks, building levels proven and commissions.

unlocks.text: The Artificer’s Apron, with checks on the map

skills.phase4: Rises from each first design: 1,000 a building.

skills.name: Scribing
skills.lore: Writing that says what it means.

unlocks.text: Books you write go in the Stacks

skills.phase4: Rises from the quests you finish.

skills.name: Illumination
skills.lore: Colour, art, the making of beautiful things.
skills.risesFrom: Art tasks, clips made and stream sessions.
skills.phase4: Rises from the quests you finish.

skills.name: Scholarship
skills.lore: Study, reading, the patient kind of learning.
skills.phase4: Rises from the quests you finish.

skills.name: Stewardship
skills.lore: Keeping a life running.
skills.phase4: Rises from the quests you finish.

skills.name: Command
skills.lore: Leading a crew well.
skills.phase4: Rises from crew sessions watched to the end, and from needs-you answered within 15 minutes.

skills.name: Focus
skills.lore: The stillness of real work.

unlocks.text: Milo lights the Lighthouse for you, once

skills.phase4: Rises from every focus session you finish: 1,000 a session.

skills.name: Hearthkeeping
skills.lore: Resting well, stopping on time.
skills.risesFrom: Honoured rests, evening bells and Stilldays.

unlocks.text: Sister Mara’s blessing: a tenth more Embers the day after a Stillday

skills.phase4: Rises from every honoured rest: 400 a rest.

skills.name: Tidereading
skills.lore: Knowing when things are due, and being there.

unlocks.text: The Harbormaster’s Spyglass, with a 7-day view

skills.phase4: Comes with Mistmere and the Tide.

skills.name: Woodcutting
skills.lore: Felling trees for logs, tier by tier.
skills.risesFrom: Logs chopped in the wilds and the vale.
skills.phase4: Rises from every log you chop: 25 a log.

skills.name: Fishing
skills.lore: A line in the vale’s waters, and further out.
skills.phase4: Rises from what Milo gathers while you focus.

skills.name: Foraging
skills.lore: Herbs, berries and dyes from the hedgerows.
skills.phase4: Rises from what Milo gathers while you focus.

skills.name: Mining
skills.lore: Ore and stone from the vale and the hills.
skills.phase4: Rises from what Milo gathers while you focus.

skills.name: Gardening
skills.lore: Orchard fruit, flowers, the Blossomfield and thousand-year saplings.
skills.risesFrom: Tending the orchard and the Blossomfield.
skills.phase4: Rises from the quests you finish.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.lore: Campfire meals that give the company a boon until the next Campfire.
skills.phase4: Rises from the quests you finish and what you cook at the fire.

skills.name: Smithing
skills.lore: Tools and gear from ore; Brannoch teaches past 70.
skills.phase4: Comes with Mistmere and the Tide.

skills.name: Crafting
skills.lore: Cloth, leather, glass, jewellery and lanterns.
skills.phase4: Comes with Mistmere and the Tide.

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.lore: Potions from herbs, like a brew of clear morning or a hearthberry cordial.
skills.phase4: Comes with Mistmere and the Tide.

skills.name: Construction
skills.lore: Building cosmetics, decor, bridges, statues and your cabin.
skills.phase4: Rises from the quests you finish.

skills.name: Cartography
skills.lore: Clearing fog, mapping regions, finding secret paths.
skills.risesFrom: Charting new ground in the wilds.
skills.phase4: Rises from every new chunk of the wilds you chart: 40 a chunk.

skills.name: Wayfaring
skills.lore: Shortcuts and fast travel.
skills.risesFrom: Lighting lanterns and travelling between them.
skills.phase4: Rises from each lantern you light for the first time, and from lantern travel, up to 10 trips a day.

skills.name: Warding
skills.lore: Turn-based tactical fights with the Company. It opens options, never power.
skills.risesFrom: Every fight, bow and stitch, as much as the Road gains.

unlocks.text: Ready: hold an action for a trigger
Three playbook rules for each companion
Set the ambush while the party’s unseen
Six playbook rules for each companion

skills.phase4: Rises from every fight, bow and stitch, as much as the Road gains.

skills.name: Seamcraft
skills.lore: Stitching rifts, weaving genre essences into fusion gear and building skins, bottling bright rifts.
skills.phase4: Rises from every rift you stitch: 300 and 30 a depth for a wild one, 500 for a real one.

skills.name: Spellcraft
skills.lore: Casting, learning spells and collecting Small Spells.
skills.risesFrom: Knacks and spells cast in a fight.
skills.phase4: Rises from knacks and spells cast in a fight: 5 a knack, and 40 for each circle of a spell.
